summary.tldr: Gives effect to the Red River Métis Self-Government Recognition and Implementation Treaty and makes related changes to other laws.
what_it_does: Gives effect to the Red River Métis Self-Government Recognition and Implementation Treaty.
Makes consequential amendments to other Acts.
summary.background: The Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations introduced the bill in the House of Commons on 12 February 2026, and it received first reading.
